verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows API access tokens, a CLI, and MCP server integration (docs-37, docs-12, docs-10/11) that could theoretically enable programmatic control, but nothing explicitly documents bulk/batch operations (e.g., bulk flag updates, bulk targeting changes across many items) as a capability. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or CLI commands, documentation of multi-item bulk edits, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows.
